plan.summary: BRO-4656 tour audit: The Only Critic review of The Outsiders (Mar 9 2026) reviews the Broadway in Detroit tour stop (Fisher Theatre, Mar 3-15 2026) but counts on the-outsiders-2024 (Broadway). Flag it wrongProduction with a tour reason; the daily tour sweep then moves it to the-outsiders-tour-2025. Also the Star Tribune review of The Great Gatsby (Jun 3 2026, 'The Broadway tour at the Orpheum', Minneapolis stop Jun 2-14 2026) and the Austin Chronicle review of The Outsiders (Oct 27 2025, 'rolled into Bass Concert Hall last week for a limited Broadway in Austin run', Austin stop Oct 21-26 2025). Both carry wrongProductionOverride/ManualClear from clear-stale-wrong-production-flags.js (2026-08-26), which confirmed each is a real review of the title, not which production; clear the ManualClear marker and flag them (wrongProductionOverride is not plan-editable and is harmless once the file sits on the tour) so the sweep moves them to the tour.
